objective: Reject non-standard JSON constants at the backend read-model boundary and encode every response with strict JSON, so a non-finite value can neither make readiness claim a broken source is usable nor produce a response body a strict client cannot parse.
acceptance: local JSONL rejects NaN, positive infinity and negative infinity at every nesting depth before caching or summarizing a run
the remote event-source path uses the same strict decoding rule, so it cannot be weaker than the local one
a run whose source uses a non-standard constant is not cached as valid, and a corrected file is readable afterwards
every backend JSON response is encoded with allow_nan=False
a payload that cannot be encoded produces a stable 503 with no success headers already sent and without echoing the offending value
readiness and data APIs fail closed for a non-finite source while the liveness endpoint stays live
finite controls still load and every successful response parses with a strict JSON parser
duplicate-key and event-contract validation from the existing implementation are unchanged
evidence: focused boundary test output for all three non-finite constants, nested occurrences, cache behaviour after a correction, and the unencodable-response 503 path
demonstration that the focused tests fail against the previous implementation and pass against the fix
confirmation that the pre-existing dashboard backend tests still pass unchanged
full repository test and Task Packet gate output
stop_conditions: a non-standard JSON package or a response-format redesign is required
the fix requires changing the public API shape or error codes other than the new unencodable-response 503
an interfaces schema or libs/contracts change is required
a modification outside allowed_paths is required
